note: Wall-clock limits on single operations of this task's evaluation, on the declared hardware and deployment. They are resource limits, not throughput objectives or per-token service targets. An operation that exhausts its limit on a healthy host fails for lack of resources; a limit here is never shortened by an enclosing wrapper.
hardware: eight NVIDIA H100 80GB GPUs; the TP4/BF16 deployments of launch.py (tp4, apc, apc-pressure) on the first four, dp2 on all eight

clocks.startup: server process spawn through a ready health response, including model load and startup compilation
clocks.rebuild: start of the documented editable build (build.sh) through its successful completion
clocks.http_workload: one request, or one explicitly submitted concurrent batch, whose largest input is below long_input_tokens: client dispatch through the complete response(s), including queueing and first-use compilation
clocks.http_workload_long: the same, when any input is at least long_input_tokens
clocks.component_invocation: one loaded-layer inspection, sample, timing or other instrumented runtime invocation: dispatch through every rank's record, including setup, warmup, compilation, prescribed repetitions, synchronization and readback
clocks.engine_test_file: one existing-engine unit-test file process: collection and all selected cases in that file, including compilation
clocks.action: one non-inference parser, configuration or identity action: dispatch through its complete record
clocks.teardown: one server or worker group: TERM, then KILL after 10 s if needed, including reaping
